experiments.experiment_label: Luciferase mRNA-LNP hepatotropism in healthy mice
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: We confirm specific hepatotropism of mRNA-LNP via intravenous injection of firefly luciferase encoding mRNA-LNP
experiments.distinctness_reason: Different payload (luciferase vs growth factors) and purpose (confirm hepatotropism) from other experiments.

experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In homeostasis, HGF mRNA-LNP efficiently induce hepatocyte proliferation.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Different payload (HGF only) and context (healthy) compared to other experiments with combination or disease models.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF+EGF mRNA-LNP in chronic NAFLD model
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In a chronic liver injury mouse model recapitulating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, injections of both HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP sharply reverse steatosis and accelerate restoration of liver function.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Different disease context (chronic NAFLD) and combination payload compared to healthy or acute liver injury experiments.

experiments.experiment_label: HGF+EGF mRNA-LNP in acute acetaminophen injury model
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: Likewise, HGF and EGF mRNA-LNP accelerate liver regeneration after acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury with rapid return to baseline ALT levels.
experiments.biological_model_mention: acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury mouse model
experiments.distinctness_reason: Different disease context (acute acetaminophen injury) compared to other experiments with healthy or chronic NAFLD models.
